cloud.title: Get the key from Tuya Cloud
cloud.description:
This method **only works if the robot is in the Tuya Smart or Smart Life app**. Branded apps such as Vactidy's cannot be linked to a Tuya project: they only offer a code scanner to add household members.

If you use the Vactidy app, close this form and choose *I already have the local key*.

1. Sign in at **iot.tuya.com** and open **Cloud → Project Management**.
2. Open your project (create one with industry *Smart Home* if you have none).
3. Copy **Access ID** and **Access Secret** from *Overview*.
4. Inside the project, **Devices → Link Tuya App account**: add the account and scan the code from Tuya Smart or Smart Life.

The region is detected automatically.

{detail}

data_description.client_id: Found in *Overview* of the project (iot.tuya.com, Cloud → Project Management).
data_description.client_secret: Next to the Access ID, in the same panel.
data_description.device_id: If the robot does not appear in the list, type its ID here. With the local key nothing needs to be linked.

cloud_device.title: Choose the robot
cloud_device.description: Robots found in your Tuya account (region {region}). Pick the one you want to add.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the robot on the local network.
error.invalid_auth: The local key was rejected. Check the key and the protocol version.
error.unsupported_device: The device answered, but it does not report the expected data points. It is probably a different robot model.
error.invalid_cloud_auth: Tuya rejected the credentials or the signature. Check the Access ID and Access Secret (no stray spaces) and that the system clock is correct.
error.cloud_not_linked: The project has no permission over the device. This only works when the account is linked from Tuya Smart or Smart Life.
error.cloud_device_not_found: That ID does not appear in the Tuya account. With the Vactidy app this is expected: it cannot be linked.
error.cloud_error: Unexpected error talking to Tuya Cloud. Try again later.
